notes.title: Achievment Update
notes.content:
*Added Achievments to game (Harder to earn achievments coming in a further update)
*Fixed start game button saying create server
*Fixed the strongman not spawing when 2nd phase of gluttony fight
*Fixed gluttony never dying after 3 hits
*Added more light bombs to neighborhood level
*Added a note to explain how to kill Gluttony

notes.title: Quality Update
notes.content:
*Added ability to change quality at start of the game
*Added Notes for lore in levels
*Improved textures for first level
*Adding loading screens
Note: With the quality settings in place some textures MIGHT take a while to load. So you might see missing textures though they should fix themselves upon waiting a set time.
